selection_rationale: Concentrated gun line of battle: three battleships as the armored core deliver massive spinal and turret firepower, destroyers add spinal guns and hulls to absorb torpedoes, and the frigates screen with extra PD. Nineteen PD lasers fleet-wide blinds torpedo saturation while our coilguns break anything that closes inside 300 km.
formation_rationale: Battleships form a tight central anvil ~70 km apart so their PD envelopes fully overlap against torpedo strikes; the two frigates nestle just behind and between them to thicken that same PD bubble. The three destroyers advance as dispersed fangs 80-90 km ahead of the anvil on wide lateral/vertical offsets - they present a hard-to-solve spinal target, can screen the line of battle from early torpedo runs, and push forward for their own torpedo launches while enemy fire is drawn to the battleship mass.
